title: nwwa-1998-world-heavyweight
label: The Rock
how: already billed champion by the 29 August 1999 “Fall Classic: War Games”
note: The surviving record never shows how or when the Rock regained the title from Buff Tortoise (champion as of the 30 May 1999 “Slamfest”); this reign is registered from the earliest point the record actually shows him holding it again.

title: nwwa-1998-world-heavyweight
label: Buff Tortoise
how: won a World Title vs. Title ladder match against The Rock, with interference from a third man, Cougar

title: nwwa-1998-world-heavyweight
label: Hellwolf
how: retained against White Tiger and Joe E. Awesome
note: How or when Hellwolf actually won the title from The Rock (billed champion as recently as August 1999) is not in the surviving record; this reign is registered from the earliest point the record actually shows him holding it.

title: nwwa-1998-international
label: Kirk
how: already billed champion by the 30 May 1999 "Slamfest"
note: The surviving record never shows Kirk winning the title; this reign is registered from the earliest point he is shown holding it.

title: nwwa-1998-international
label: Gorilla
how: defeated Rambacklash for the vacated title
note: How and when Kirk's own Intercontinental/International reign ended, and the title was declared vacant, before this match is not in the surviving record.

title: nwwa-1998-internet
label: Scott Credible
how: won a six-man battle royal for the inaugural title

title: nwwa-1998-national-heavyweight
label: Buff Bagwell
how: already billed champion by the 30 May 1999 “Slamfest,” where he retained against Dale Hill
note: The surviving record never shows Bagwell winning the title; this reign is registered from the earliest point he is shown holding it.

title: nwwa-1998-tag-team
label: Triple H
how: already billed “one half of the NWWA Tag Team Champions” by the 29 August 1999 “Fall Classic: War Games”
note: The surviving record never names his partner or shows how the team won the belt; this reign is registered from the earliest, and only, point the record shows him holding it.
